stem.text: The equations for two reactions are shown.
The two reactions have similar reaction mechanisms.
The initial rate of reaction X is greater than that of reaction Y when measured under identical conditions of temperature, pressure and reactant concentration.

items: The activation energy for reaction X is less than that of reaction Y.
The $\text{Br–Br}$ bond is weaker than the $\text{Cl–Cl}$ bond.
A higher frequency of collisions between molecules of $\text{NOBr}$ occur than between molecules of $\text{NOCl}$.
